3674-the-dragon-and-the-raven-or-the-day.title: Or The Days of King Alfred
3674-the-dragon-and-the-raven-or-the-day.creator: G. A. Henty
3674-the-dragon-and-the-raven-or-the-day.description: A book by G. A. Henty. f Alfred's reign--events which have exercised an influence upon the whole future of the English people. School histories pass briefly over them; and the incident of the burned cake is that which is, of all the actions of a great and glorious reign, the most prominent in boys' minds. In this story I have tried to supply the deficiency.

arxiv-2012-10808.title: Old recurrence formulae for growth series of Coxeter groups
arxiv-2012-10808.creator: Jan Dymara (Wrocław)
arxiv-2012-10808.description: Abstract . Several classical formulae for the growth series of a Coxeter group are proved in a new way, using the structure of the Coxeter complex, the Davis complex, or the Tits non-complex. 2010 Mathematics Subject Classification Primary 20F55; Secondary 57M07 1. Introduction Throughout this paper (W,S) is a Coxeter system.

arxiv-2104-02241.title: Direct Observation of an Incommensurate Charge Density Wave in the BiS 2 -based Superconductor NdO 1-x F x BiS 2
arxiv-2104-02241.creator: Jooseop Lee 1,2, Masanori Nagao 3, Yoshikazu Mizuguchi 4, Jacob Ruff 2
arxiv-2104-02241.description: Abstract The nature of superconductivity in BiS 2 -based superconductors has been controversial while ab-initio calculations proposed this system in close proximity to a charge-density-wave (CDW) phase. Using high-energy high-flux X-ray diffraction, we reveal an intrinsic and long-range CDW phase coexisting with superconductivity in NdO 1-x F x BiS 2 superconductor ( x x = 0.37 and 0.3).

arxiv-2106-12761.title: On estimates of the order of approximation of functions of several variables in the anisotropic Lorentz - Karamata space
arxiv-2106-12761.creator: G. Akishev
arxiv-2106-12761.description: Abstract Abstract. In this paper we consider anisotropic Lorentz-Karamata space 2\pi of periodic functions of m variables and Nikol’skii–Besov’s class . In this paper, we establish order-sharp estimates of the best approximation by trigonometric polynomials with harmonic numbers from the step hyperbolic cross of functions from the Nikol’skii - Besov class in the norm of the anisotropic Lorentz-Karamata space.

arxiv-2208-00378.title: On local representation densities of hermitian forms and special cycles II
arxiv-2208-00378.creator: Sungyoon Cho
arxiv-2208-00378.description: Abstract . In this paper, we prove that there are certain relations among representation densities and provide an efficient way to compute representation densities by using these relations. As an application, we compute some arithmetic intersection numbers of special cycles on unitary Shimura varieties and propose a conjecture on these. 1.

arxiv-2210-01987.creator: Dhrupad Bhardwaj db4045@nyu.edu, Julia Kempe jk185@nyu.edu, Artem Vysogorets amv458@nyu.edu, Angela M. Teng at2507@nyu.edu, Evaristus C. Ezekwem ece278@nyu.edu
arxiv-2210-01987.description: Abstract This work proposes a new method to sequentially train deep neural networks on multiple tasks without suffering catastrophic forgetting, while endowing it with the capability to quickly adapt to unseen tasks. Starting from existing work on network masking ( Wortsman et al.

arxiv-2302-06133.title: Deep Transfer Tensor Factorization for Multi-View Learning
arxiv-2302-06133.creator: Penghao Jiang, Ke Xin, Chunxi Li
arxiv-2302-06133.description: Abstract This paper studies the data sparsity problem in multi-view learning. To solve data sparsity problem in multiview ratings, we propose a generic architecture of deep transfer tensor factorization (DTTF) by integrating deep learning and cross-domain tensor factorization, where the side information is embedded to provide effective compensation for the tensor sparsity.

arxiv-2402-08381.title: MAVRL: Learn to Fly in Cluttered Environments with Varying Speed
arxiv-2402-08381.creator: Hang Yu, Christophe De Wagter, Guido C. H. E de Croon
arxiv-2402-08381.description: Abstract Many existing obstacle avoidance algorithms overlook the crucial balance between safety and agility, especially in environments of varying complexity. In our study, we introduce an obstacle avoidance pipeline based on reinforcement learning. This pipeline enables drones to adapt their flying speed according to the environmental complexity.

arxiv-2501-17578.title: Music2Latent2: Audio Compression with Summary Embeddings and Autoregressive Decoding Thanks: This work is supported by the EPSRC UKRI Centre for Doctoral Training in Artificial Intelligence and Music (EP/S022694/1) and Sony Computer Science Laboratories Paris.
arxiv-2501-17578.creator: Marco Pasini, Stefan Lattner, György Fazekas
arxiv-2501-17578.description: Abstract Efficiently compressing high-dimensional audio signals into a compact and informative latent space is crucial for various tasks, including generative modeling and music information retrieval (MIR). Existing audio autoencoders, however, often struggle to achieve high compression ratios while preserving audio fidelity and facilitating efficient downstream applications.

arxiv-2506-15984.title: Direct Inference of Nuclear Equation-of-State Parameters from Gravitational-Wave Observations
arxiv-2506-15984.creator: Ingo Tews
arxiv-2506-15984.description: Abstract The observation of neutron star mergers with gravitational waves (GWs) has provided a new method to constrain the dense-matter equation of state (EOS) and to better understand its nuclear physics. However, inferring nuclear microphysics from GW observations necessitates the sampling of EOS model parameters that serve as input for each EOS used during the GW data analysis.

pmc-10647340.title: Revealing the Structure Formation on Polyglycerol Citrate Polymers—An Environmentally Friendly Polyester as a Seed-Coating Material
pmc-10647340.creator: Amanda S. Giroto, Stella F. Valle, Roger Borges, Luiz A. Colnago, Tatiana S. Ribeiro, Nicolai D. Jablonowski, Caue Ribeiro, Luiz H. C. Mattoso
pmc-10647340.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). A detailed structural investigation of a promising bio-based polymer, polyglycerol citrate polyester, obtained by the bulk polycondensation of glycerol (Gly) against citric acid (Cit) under mild reaction was performed. The reaction in conditions with and without catalyst use (sulfuric acid, H2SO4) was investigated, showing evidence that it is possible to modify the polymer solubility according to the ratio and catalyst utilization. 13C and 1H NMR indicated that synthesis catalyzed with Cit excess leads to higher esterification degrees of citrate groups.

pmc-10651075.title: Best billiard ball in the 19th century: Composite materials made of celluloid and bone as substitutes for ivory
pmc-10651075.creator: Artur Neves, Robert Friedel, Maria J Melo, Maria Elvira Callapez, Edward P Vicenzi, Thomas Lam
pmc-10651075.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). The demystification of how 19th-century novelly designed materials became significant elements of modern technological, economic, and cultural life requires a complete understanding of the material dimensions of historical artifacts. The objects frequently described as the earliest manufactured plastic products—the billiard balls made by John Wesley Hyatt and his associates from the late 1860s—are examined closely for the first time and are found to be more complex and functionally more successful than has been described.

pmc-10737173.title: AGING AND WELL-BEING: TESTING MINDFULNESS AS A MEDIATOR AND RESILIENCE AS A MODERATOR IN A NIGERIAN SAMPLE
pmc-10737173.creator: Peace Amanambu, JohnBosco Chukwuorji, Eric Allard
pmc-10737173.description: The mediating role of mindfulness on the relationship between age and affect (both positive and negative) has been established in Western samples. However, these associations have not been well considered within additional cultural contexts. The present study examined whether mindfulness mediates the relationship between increased age and both positive (PA) and negative (NA) affect.

pmc-10754695.title: Patterns of chemotherapy use in muscle-invasive bladder cancer in a tertiary centre
pmc-10754695.creator: Kylie Yen-Yi Lim, Kevin Chu, Nieroshan Rajarubendra, James Huang, David Pook, Paul Manohar, Matthew Harper, Scott Donnellan, Weranja Ranasinghe
pmc-10754695.description: ObjectivesAlthough neoadjuvant chemotherapy (NAC) has been demonstrated to have significant benefits to survival in patients with muscle-invasive bladder cancer (MIBC), the current utilization of NAC in Australia is unknown. The aim of this study was to evaluate the patterns of neoadjuvant and adjuvant chemotherapy (AC) use in patients undergoing cystectomy for MIBC at a large tertiary institution in Australia.

pmc-11650345.title: Dexamethasone: a cheap and convenient way to alleviate subsequent stenosis after thermal injury on ureter
pmc-11650345.creator: Weiping Xia, Fang Huang, Qingtian Song, Yunbo He, Bingsheng Li
pmc-11650345.description: BackgroundUreteral thermal injury (UTI) occurs when the ureter is exposed to high temperatures during surgical procedures, leading to tissue damage and ureteral stricture. Dexamethasone (DEX) has been widely used to treat a variety of diseases for its anti-inflammatory and immunosuppressant effects. However, its role in treating UTI remains unclear.

pmc-12483278.title: The viral BCL2 protein BHRF1 of Epstein–Barr virus promotes AIM2 inflammasome activation to facilitate lytic replication
pmc-12483278.creator: Qingping Lan, Xiaolin Zhang, Yifan Sun, Jing Yang, Xiaojuan Li, Ersheng Kuang
pmc-12483278.description: The absent in melanoma 2 (AIM2) protein recognizes viral and naked dsDNA and recruit apoptosis-associated speck-like protein containing CARD (ASC) to initiate inflammasome activation; however, the subversion of AIM2 activation by Epstein–Barr virus (EBV) infection remains unknown. Here, we reveal that the EBV-encoded viral BCL2 protein BHRF1 promotes AIM2 inflammasome activation.

pmc-12562452.title: Evaluation of the Effects of Lipoxin A4 and Resolvin D1 on the Severity of Transient Tachypnea of the Newborn: A Prospective Study
pmc-12562452.creator: Emrah Çığrı, Funda Çatan İnan, Sedat Gülten, Mehmet Akif Bildirici, Ayşe Ece Gökkaya, Metin Asıleren, Fethiye Yıldız, Hilmi Onur Kabukcu, Karel Allegaert
pmc-12562452.description: HighlightsOur article examines the effects of SPMs on transient neonatal tachypnea, a common condition in newborns. This study is the first clinical study conducted in this area. What are the main findings? LXA4 and RvD1 levels were found to be lower in infants with severe TTN.RvD1 and PLR are significant in predicting infants with severe TTN.

pmc-12606341.creator: Matin Kazemzadeh Bahnamirei, Mostafa Khoshhal Sarmast, Mahdi Alizadeh, Mohammad Naghi Padasht Dahkaei
pmc-12606341.description: Maintaining genetic fidelity in in vitro-regenerated plants derived from chimeric tissues presents a significant challenge during tissue culture experiments. Sansevieria trifasciata cv. Laurentii exhibits striking periclinal chimeric tissues along its leaves, which are compromised when propagating plants through leaf cuttings. In addition to establishing in vitro production of S. trifasciata cv.

pmc-12972299.title: Impact of the defined Oligo-MM12 microbiota on intestinal colonisation and dissemination of Listeria monocytogenes
pmc-12972299.creator: Monica Cazzaniga, Kardokh Kaka Bra, Mathias K. M. Herzog, Wolf-Dietrich Hardt, Marcus J. Claesson, Harsh Mathur, Cormac G. M. Gahan
pmc-12972299.description: Listeria monocytogenes is a foodborne pathogen of global concern, particularly for immunocompromised individuals at risk of severe disease. In mice, infection outcomes are strongly influenced by host immunity and gut microbiome composition. The Oligo-MM12 defined microbiota mouse model, containing a simplified community of 12 bacterial strains, offers a controlled system to study L. monocytogenes pathogenesis and microbiome interactions.

pmc-13086625.title: Is Current Evidence Sufficient to Establish the Efficacy of Botulinum Toxin A in Treating Persistent Dry Eye Disease? A Systematic Review and Meta‐Analysis of Interventional Studies With a Critical Review Using GRADE Tool
pmc-13086625.creator: Mirsaeed Abdollahi, Farbod Semnani, Hadi Vahedi, Navid Sobhi, Mahdi Mohammadkhani, Amin Nabavi, Ali Jafarizadeh
pmc-13086625.description: Background and AimsStandard management of dry eye disease (DED) relies on artificial tears, anti‐inflammatory therapy, and punctal occlusion in selected cases. However, some patients continue to report persistent symptoms. The present article reviewed the efficacy of Botulinum Toxin A (BTX‐A) for DED that remained symptomatic after these interventions, excluding patients with blepharospasm or hemifacial spasm.

pmc-13127982.title: Effect of Drought Stress and Osmopriming on the Growth and Yield of Tadong Upland Rice in Sabah, Malaysia
pmc-13127982.creator: Robin Ah Hee Lim, Evelyn Shin Rou Koay, Mok Sam Lum
pmc-13127982.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Drought stress remains one of the most significant challenges facing the development and production of upland rice. Seed osmopriming represents a method to enhance plant growth and offers potential against drought stress. This study aimed to investigate the effects of polyethylene glycol (PEG) 6000 seed osmopriming and drought stress on the growth, yield, physiological and biochemical parameters of Tadong upland rice.

pmc-13433874.title: An integrated multi-omics analysis reveals a core epigenetically-activated transcriptional network driving oncogenic signaling in acute myeloid leukemia
pmc-13433874.creator: Lihua Zeng, Haohao Lei, Jingnan Bi, Guowei Run, Bizhen Yu, Linhua Ji
pmc-13433874.description: PurposeAcute Myeloid Leukemia (AML) is driven by complex interactions between genetic mutations and epigenetic dysregulation. While alterations in chromatin modifiers are frequent, the precise downstream transcriptional networks they enable and how these networks execute the leukemogenic program remain incompletely defined.MethodsWe employed an integrative bioinformatics strategy.

pmc-13617467.title: The Surgical Timing Gap in Elderly Hip Fracture Management: A Regional Systems Analysis
pmc-13617467.creator: Abdelrahim Shaaeldin, Osama F Almaghthawi, Leena M. Salem, Alhassan Yousef Alturkestani, Raghad A Sokail, Nesreen M Abujabal, Eilaf H Hawsah, Fatima J Alnakli, Dina Algheryafi, Lena F Alahmadi
